strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software a ɛhwɛ Van Sales ne Sales Reps so
strings.tierB.home.description: Software ma distributors: invoice ne receipt fi rep fon so, van stock, sika a wɔgye, akwan ne nsra. Ɛyɛ adwuma berɛ a intanɛt nni hɔ, ɛyɛ sync akyiri yi.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Hwɛ wo sales reps so fi nsra a edi kan kosi sika a wɔgye a etwa toɔ
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales yɛ cloud platform (van sales ne sales rep software) ma distribution ne wholesale adwumakuo a wɔwɔ sales reps (adetɔnfoɔ) a wɔnam kwan so. Reps no de wɔn fon yɛ invoice ne receipt na wɔtintim, wɔhwɛ van stock so na wɔkyerɛw wɔn nsra; na managers (sohwɛfoɔ) hunu sales, sika a wɔagye ne ɛka a ɛda customer biara so berɛ a ɛrekɔ so no ara.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoice fi rep no fon so
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Rep no yɛ invoice no wɔ customer no sotɔɔ ano, na ɔde Bluetooth thermal printer tintim ansa na wafi sotɔɔ no mu.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Sika a wɔgye ne ɛka a ɛda customers so
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Sika biara a wɔtua no nya receipt a ɛwɔ nɔma, a wɔde aka invoice a ɛtua no ho, na ɛka a ɛda customer no so ne ne statement sesa amonom hɔ ara.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Van stock a wɔde ahyɛ rep no nsa
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Wɔhwɛ van biara stock so adeɛ biara: deɛ wɔde guu mu, deɛ wɔtɔnee, deɛ wɔsan de baeɛ ne deɛ aka, enti sɛ nsonsonoeɛ bi wɔ hɔ a, wohunu da koro no ara.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Akwan ne nsra
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Wɔkyerɛw nsra biara ne ne location, berɛ ne mfonini, na manager no hunu rep biara kwan wɔ map so.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Ɛyɛ adwuma berɛ a intanɛt nni hɔ
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Reps kɔ so tɔn nneɛma berɛ a network nni hɔ mpo. Nkrataa no twɛn wɔ fon no so, na sɛ network no san ba a, ɛkɔ server so a wonhia sɛ woyɛ hwee, na biara nkɔ hɔ mprenu.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard ma managers
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Sales, sika a wɔagye, nneɛma a wɔsan de aba, stock ne rep biara adwumayɛ wɔ baabi baako. Obiara a ɔde di dwuma wɔ ne role ne ne permissions.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Ka sɛnea wotɔn nneɛma kyerɛ yɛn
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Bisa quote anaa hyehyɛ nhyiamu. Yɛbɛhwɛ wo reps, wo akwan, wo nneɛma ne deɛ wohia wɔ invoice ho.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Siesie wo adwumakuo
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Fa wo nneɛma, wɔn bo, customers ne reps hyɛ mu, na fa wo man sika ne towtua dodoɔ (tax rate) hyɛ settings no mu.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Soma reps no kɔ kwan so
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Reps de app no gu wɔn Android anaa iPhone so, wɔhyɛ wɔn van ma, na wɔfi ase tɔn, tintim na wɔgye sika.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Hwɛ da no sɛnea ɛrekɔ so
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Web dashboard no kyerɛ sales, sika a wɔagye, van stock ne nsra berɛ a reps no da so wɔ kwan so.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales yɛ cloud platform a ɛboa ma wɔhwɛ sales reps so wɔ distribution ne wholesale adwumakuo mu. Ɛhwɛ van sales, route sales, pre-sales (order a wɔgye kan) ne direct store delivery (DSD) so. Reps de wɔn fon yɛ invoice, tintim, gye sika na wɔkyerɛw nsra, na managers fi web dashboard so hwɛ sales, sika a wɔagye, van stock ne ɛka a ɛda customers so.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: FieldSales yɛ adwuma berɛ a intanɛt nni hɔ anaa?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Aane. Rep app no kɔ so yɛ adwuma berɛ a intanɛt nni hɔ: reps yɛ invoice ne receipt na wɔtintim, wɔkyerɛw nsra na wɔde customers foforɔ ka ho, na sɛ network no san ba a, ne nyinaa kɔ server so a wonhia sɛ woyɛ hwee, na biara nkɔ hɔ mprenu. Nanso biribi baako nte saa wɔ Saudi Arabia: adwumakuo a wɔde e-invoicing integration no di dwuma hia intanɛt berɛ a wɔreyɛ invoice anaa return.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: FieldSales yɛ adwuma wɔ aman bɛn mu?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales yɛ adwuma ma distribution adwumakuo wɔ ɔman biara mu. Adwumakuo biara de ne man sika ne ne towtua dodoɔ hyɛ ne settings mu, na invoice, receipt ne reports nyinaa de di dwuma. FieldSales te Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, na yɛboa wo ma wofi ase wɔ intanɛt so denam nhyiamu, WhatsApp ne remote support so.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales tumi ne aban e-invoicing systems bɔ mu anaa?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Yɛboa Phase 2 nkabom a ɛda yɛn ne ZATCA Fatoora platform no ntam. Eyi fa adwumakuo a wɔwɔ Saudi Arabia ho. Wɔ aman foforɔ mu, Ghana ka ho, FieldSales de wo man sika ne wo towtua dodoɔ yɛ invoice. Nkabom a ɛda FieldSales ne ɔman no aban e-invoicing system ntam deɛ, ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobisa a, na ansa na yɛayɛ no, yɛne wo bɛhwɛ ɔman no ahwehwɛdeɛ. Yɛnhyɛ bɔ biara sɛ ɛne mmara hyia wɔ aman a ɛnyɛ Saudi Arabia mu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Kasa bɛn na FieldSales app no wɔ mu?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: FieldSales app no interface wɔ Arabik, Borɔfo, Frɛnkye, Tɛki kasa ne Kyaena kasa mu, na ɛwɔ saa kasa yi nko ara mu. Twi nka ho, nanso Borɔfo ka ho. Reps ne managers tumi sesa interface no kasa, na invoice a wɔatintim tumi kura kasa a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ kasa titiriw no nkyɛn. Website nkrataafa a ɛwɔ kasa foforɔ mu, te sɛ Twi kratafa yi, yɛ nkyerɛaseɛ a ɛma wohunu product no ho nsɛm.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Mɛyɛ dɛn na mafi ase de FieldSales adi dwuma?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Bisa quote, hyehyɛ nhyiamu anaa fa WhatsApp so kyerɛw yɛn. Yɛbɛsua sɛnea wo reps yɛ wɔn adwuma, na yɛaboa wo ma woasiesie wo nneɛma, wɔn bo, customers ne reps. Reps de app no gu Android anaa iPhone so, na managers de browser biara di web dashboard no ho dwuma. Smartphone nko ara ne hardware a wohia.
strings.tierB.home.cta.whatsapp: Kasa kyerɛ yɛn wɔ WhatsApp so
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: FieldSales app no interface wɔ Arabik, Borɔfo, Frɛnkye, Tɛki kasa ne Kyaena kasa mu; Twi nka ho. Nkrataafa a ɛwɔ kasa foforɔ mu kyerɛkyerɛ product no mu ma wo nimdeɛ nko ara.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van Sales Software ma Distributors wɔ Ghana | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Van sales ne route sales software: rep de ne fon tintim invoice, van stock ma adeɛ biara, sika a wɔgye ne nsra. Ɛyɛ adwuma berɛ a intanɛt nni hɔ.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Van sales software ma distributors ne wholesalers wɔ Ghana
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales yɛ van sales software ma adwumakuo a wɔn reps tɔn nneɛma fi van mu wɔ akwan so da biara. Rep no hyɛ van no ma, ɔtɔn wɔ sotɔɔ biara mu, ɔtintim invoice, ɔgye sika na ɔkyerɛw nneɛma a wɔsan de ba, ne nyinaa wɔ fon app baako so. Manager no hunu deɛ wɔde guu van biara mu, deɛ wɔtɔnee, sika a wɔgyee ne deɛ aka.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Ɛdeɛn ne van sales software?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Van sales software, a wɔfrɛ no cash van anaa route sales software nso, hwɛ adetɔn kwan bi so: rep no de stock gu kaa no mu, na ɔtɔn, ɔde ma, ɔyɛ invoice na ɔgye sika wɔ nsra baako mu. Ɛsi invoice nkrataa nhoma ne fon frɛ a wɔyɛ no anwummerɛ ananmu. Ɛkyerɛw adetɔn biara, sika biara a wɔtua ne nneɛma biara a wɔsan de ba sɛ krataa, enti wotumi de stock ne sika toto ho da koro no ara. Ma manager no, ɛma nsɛmmisa mmiɛnsa ho mmuaeɛ anwummerɛ biara: rep biara tɔnee deɛn, rep biara gyee sika ahe, na deɛn na aka wɔ van biara mu?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Da baako wɔ kwan so
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Da no fi ase berɛ a wɔde nneɛma a wɔakyerɛw fi warehouse gu van no mu. Wɔ sotɔɔ biara mu, rep no bue customer no krataa, ɔde nneɛma ka ho fi list anaa barcode so, ɔyɛ invoice na ɔde thermal printer tintim. Wɔde receipt kyerɛw sika a wɔtua, na sɛ wɔsan de nneɛma bi ba a, wɔkyerɛw deɛ nti a wɔsan de baeɛ. Da no awieeɛ, nneɛma a aka wɔ van no mu no, wɔsan de kɔ warehouse. Saa berɛ no nyinaa mu, manager no nhia sɛ ɔfrɛ obiara, efisɛ ɔtumi fi web dashboard so hwɛ rep biara sales, sika a wagye ne ne nsra.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Wɔyɛɛ no maa baabi a network yɛ mmerɛw
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Distribution akwan fa adan ase, industrial area ne nkuraa a network nyɛ papa wɔ hɔ. FieldSales rep app no kora customers, nneɛma ne wɔn bo wɔ fon no so, enti rep no tumi yɛ nkrataa na ɔtintim berɛ a intanɛt nni hɔ mpo. Krataa biara wɔ n'ankasa ID (unique key), enti ɛkɔ server so mprɛ baako pɛ, sɛ wɔsan bɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔde bɛkɔ mpo a. Saudi adwumakuo a wɔde e-invoicing integration di dwuma hia intanɛt berɛ a wɔreyɛ invoice ne returns. Receipt, nsra ne customers foforɔ deɛ, ɛda so yɛ adwuma berɛ a intanɛt nni hɔ ma wɔn nso.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Sika a wɔgye ne van stock a wɔde ahyɛ rep nsa
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Sika a rep no kura wɔ kwan so no, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ so pɛpɛɛpɛ sɛnea wɔhwɛ stock so no ara. Sika biara a wɔgye nya receipt a ɛwɔ nɔma, a wotumi de ka invoice a ɛtua no ho, na ɛka a ɛda customer no so sesa amonom hɔ ara. Wɔbu van stock adeɛ biara: deɛ wɔde guu mu yi deɛ wɔtɔnee, fa nneɛma a wɔsan de baeɛ ne nsesaeɛ a wɔakyerɛw ka ho, enti managers tumi de toto deɛ wɔakan ankasa ho ansa na rep no akɔ fie. Wotumi kyekyɛ returns mu: deɛ ɛyɛ papa, deɛ asɛe anaa deɛ wɔde sesa foforɔ (exchange), na manager no na ɔsi gyinaeɛ sɛ nneɛma a wɔsan de aba no bɛsan akɔ van no stock a wɔbɛtumi atɔn mu anaa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ɛyɛ ma hwan?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales fata distributors ne wholesalers a wɔtɔn nneɛma a ɛtɔn ntɛm (FMCG), te sɛ aduane, nneɛma a wɔnom, nneɛma a wɔde hohoro adeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde hwɛ honam, ne adwumakuo biara a ne reps kɔsra sotɔɔ ahodoɔ wɔ akwan so. Ɛboa van sales, pre-sales orders ne direct store delivery. Ɛnyɛ ERP a biribiara wɔ mu: ɛne wo accounting anaa ERP system bɔ mu denam API so. Managers na wɔkyerɛ deɛ rep biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔyɛ, te sɛ discount a ɔde bɛma, adetɔn a ne bo ba fam sen list price anaa customers foforɔ a ɔde bɛka ho.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Nsonsonoeɛ bɛn na ɛda van sales ne pre-sales ntam?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Van sales mu no, rep no kura stock na ɔde ma, ɔyɛ invoice na ɔgye sika wɔ nsra koro no ara mu. Pre-sales mu no, rep no gye order, na warehouse no de nneɛma no brɛ akyiri yi. FieldSales boa mmienu no nyinaa, enti adwumakuo tumi de cash vans di dwuma wɔ akwan bi so na wɔgye orders wɔ akwan foforɔ so. Mmienu no nyinaa mu, invoice, sika a wɔagye ne ɛka a ɛda customers so wɔ system baako mu, na managers hunu ne nyinaa wɔ reports koro no ara mu.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Mɛyɛ dɛn na mahwɛ van bi akontaa da no awieeɛ?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales kyerɛ adeɛ biara a ɛwɔ van biara mu: dodoɔ a wɔde guu mu, deɛ wɔtɔnee, deɛ wɔsan de baeɛ ne deɛ aka. Fa deɛ aka no toto deɛ wokan ankasa ho, kyerɛw nsonsonoeɛ biara sɛ nsesaeɛ a wɔakyerɛw, na fa deɛ aka no nyinaa san kɔ warehouse prɛko. Enti ɔkyena, van no de akontaa a ɛho tew na wonim fi ase.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Hardware bɛn na van sales rep hia?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android anaa iPhone. Bluetooth thermal printer nyɛ nhyɛ; ɛma rep no tumi de invoice anaa receipt a wɔatintim ma customer no. FieldSales ntɔn hardware, na ɛnhyɛ sɛ wode printer brand pɔtee bi bɛdi dwuma. Managers de kɔmputa anaa fon browser biara di web dashboard no ho dwuma.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales tumi ne yɛn accounting system bɔ mu anaa?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Aane. FieldSales wɔ API a ɛma wo accounting anaa ERP system tumi ne platform no sesa customers, nneɛma, invoice, receipt ne stock a ɛkɔ na ɛba ho nsɛm. Wo team anaa integrator na ɔde API documentation no yɛ nkabom no.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales: Ɔman Biara Sika, Towtua ne E-Invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales yɛ adwuma ma distributors wɔ ɔman biara mu. Hwɛ ɔman biara sika, towtua ne e-invoicing tebea wɔ table baako mu.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales yɛ adwuma ma distribution adwumakuo wɔ ɔman biara mu. Adwumakuo biara paw ne man, ne sika ne ne towtua dodoɔ wɔ ne settings mu, na invoice, receipt ne reports di saa akyi. Aban e-invoicing integration yɛ adwuma wɔ Saudi Arabia nko ara. Aman a aka no nyinaa mu, ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobisa a. Table a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha no kyerɛ ɔman biara sika, towtua anaa VAT dodoɔ a wɔtaa de di dwuma, ne sɛ aban e-invoicing nkabom yɛ adwuma anaa ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobisa a.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Yɛboa Phase 2 nkabom a ɛda yɛn ne ZATCA Fatoora platform no ntam
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Adwumakuo biara na ɛde sika ne towtua dodoɔ hyɛ ne settings mu. Dodoɔ a ɛwɔ table yi mu yɛ akwankyerɛ kɛkɛ na ɛtumi sesa; bisa wo tax ho ɔfotufoɔ na hwɛ mmara a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei. Dash (—) kyerɛ sɛ yɛnkyerɛw towtua dodoɔ titiriw biara mma saa ɔman no.
strings.tierB.about.title: FieldSales ho nsɛm
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales yɛ cloud software ma distribution adwumakuo a wɔwɔ sales reps wɔ kwan so. Wɔhyɛɛ no ase afe 2026 mu wɔ Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (ne din wɔ Arabik mu ne فيلد سيلز) yɛ cloud platform ma distribution ne wholesale adwumakuo a wɔwɔ sales reps wɔ kwan so. Wɔhyɛɛ FieldSales ase afe 2026 mu, na ɛte Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Ɛyɛ adwuma ma adwumakuo wɔ ɔman biara mu, na adwumakuo biara de ne man sika ne ne towtua dodoɔ hyɛ ne settings mu. Yɛn customers yɛ adwumakuo a wɔnam reps so tɔn na wɔde nneɛma brɛ: distributors, wholesalers ne manufacturers a wɔwɔ wɔn ankasa kaa a wɔde tɔn nneɛma.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Yɛyɛ system baako a ɛka field adwuma no nyinaa bom: invoice a rep de ne fon tintim, receipt ne ɛka a ɛda customers so, van stock a wɔde ahyɛ rep nsa, akwan ne nsra a location ne mfonini ka ho, ne web dashboard ma managers. Rep app no yɛ adwuma wɔ Android ne iPhone so, ɛkɔ so yɛ adwuma berɛ a intanɛt nni hɔ, na sɛ network san ba a ɛyɛ sync. Adwumakuo tumi de API ka FieldSales ne wɔn accounting anaa ERP system bom, enti ɛho nhia sɛ wɔkyerɛw field nsɛm no mprenu.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Yɛka product no ho asɛm sɛnea ɛte ankasa. Yɛboa Phase 2 nkabom a ɛda yɛn ne ZATCA Fatoora platform no ntam. Aman foforɔ mu deɛ, nkabom a ɛda yɛn ne aban systems ntam wɔ hɔ sɛ wobisa a. App no interface wɔ Arabik, Borɔfo, Frɛnkye, Tɛki kasa ne Kyaena kasa mu; Twi nka ho. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wo ne yɛn kasa a, bisa quote, hyehyɛ nhyiamu anaa fa WhatsApp so kyerɛw yɛn.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Kasa kyerɛ FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Kasa kyerɛ FieldSales team: bisa quote, hyehyɛ nhyiamu anaa kasa kyerɛ yɛn wɔ WhatsApp so fa field sales ne van sales software ho.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Ka sɛnea wo reps tɔn nneɛma ɛnnɛ ne deɛ wopɛ sɛ wosesa kyerɛ yɛn. Bisa quote, hyehyɛ nhyiamu anaa fa WhatsApp so kyerɛw yɛn, na yɛn team mu nipa bi bɛbua wo. Customers a wɔde FieldSales di dwuma dedaw no nso tumi fa saa akwan yi ara so bisa mmoa. Ɛboa sɛ wobɛka wo man, wo reps dodoɔ, ne sɛ wɔtɔn nneɛma fi van mu, wɔgye orders anaa wɔyɛ mmienu no nyinaa.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Hyehyɛ nhyiamu wɔ intanɛt so na wo ne yɛn team nkasa. Yɛde nhwɛsoɔ a ɛbɛn wo nneɛma ne wo akwan bɛkyerɛ wo sɛnea rep bi yɛ ne da mu adwuma wɔ app no mu ne sɛnea manager dashboard no te, na yɛabua wo nsɛmmisa a ɛfa setup ho.
